name: DocuServiceBuild
description: Render the Markdown in this repository into a static site ready to deploy to Azure Static Web Apps. No configuration required.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/imjkrao/docuService#readme) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/imjkrao/docuService/issues)

Pair this task with **Azure Static Web Apps deploy** and point its `app_location` at `$(DocuServiceBuild.outputDirectory)`.
author: docuservice

inputs.name: sourceDirectory
inputs.label: Source directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder containing the Markdown files, and optionally `docuservice.json`. Defaults to the repository root.

inputs.name: outputDirectory
inputs.label: Output directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where the generated site is written. Relative paths resolve against the source directory. Must not be the source directory itself.

inputs.name: basePath
inputs.label: Base path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set this when the site is hosted under a sub-path, for example `/docs/`. Leave as `/` for a site at the domain root.

inputs.name: quiet
inputs.label: Suppress per-page logging
inputs.helpMarkDown: Log only the summary instead of one line per page. Useful for repositories with many hundreds of Markdown files.

outputVariables.name: outputDirectory
outputVariables.description: Absolute path of the generated site. Use it as `app_location` for the Azure Static Web Apps deploy task.

messages.SourceDirectoryNotFound: Source directory not found: %s. Check the 'Source directory' input.
messages.CliNotFound: The bundled docuservice CLI was not found at %s. The extension package is incomplete; please report this issue.
messages.BuildFailed: docuservice build failed with exit code %s.
